documents.title: Guidelines for Use of AI at UF
documents.summary: A long university-wide framework (Provost, ai.ufl.edu) with Dos and Don'ts, principles, and separate guidance for instructors, students, researchers and HR. It encourages AI use, requires citation and use of approved tools, and offers three optional syllabus levels that instructors choose.
documents.stance_why: The guidelines set no single rule: they say syllabus guidelines "may vary by college, department, and/or course" and offer three optional levels (AI-Permitted, Some AI, No AI) described as "not formal statements or policies", so the decision is delegated to instructors and tiers are listed.

documents.stance_why: The student section says students "must strictly comply with the instructions of their course instructor" about AI, and the policy adds no AI-specific allow or ban of its own, so the stance is delegates.
